title: A bukás után új út: a passzív ellenállás (After Defeat, a New Path)
grammar: Concessive Connectors, Purpose Clauses & Dual Constitutional Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how Hungarians resisted Bach's rule without weapons after 1849.
I can use annak ellenére, hogy to say that something happened despite a setback.
I can name the Bach era, passive resistance and tax refusal in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the resistance and answer questions about it.
